description: This Java abstract class provides validation logic for entities with OTA (Over-The-Air) packages, ensuring correct association with firmware and software OTA packages based on tenant, type, data, and device profile.

classes.name: AbstractHasOtaPackageValidator
classes.description: An abstract validator class for entities with OTA packages, providing methods to validate OTA package associations.

methods.name: validateOtaPackage
methods.description: Validates OTA packages (firmware and software) associated with an entity, ensuring they exist, belong to the same tenant, have correct type, contain data or URL, and match device profile.

methods.name: validateOtaPackage
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of a specific OTA package against tenant, type, device profile, data presence, and URL.

methods.name: prepareMsg
methods.description: Prepares validation error messages with OTA package type in lowercase.
